description: Unified tool for querying LambdaTest automation resources: builds, sessions, tests, and logs. Supports listing builds, getting build details, deleting/updating/stopping builds, listing sessions in a build, fetching test details, and retrieving test logs (command, network, console, selenium, instrumentation). Use logType "instrumentation" for XCUI and Espresso test logs.

action.description: The action to perform on the resource

buildId.description: Build ID — required for build get/delete/update/stop and optional for session list

logType.description: Log type — required when resource is "logs"

pageNumber.description: Page number for command log pagination

platform.description: The platform type: "web" for browser automation, "app" for mobile app automation

sessionId.description: Session ID — required for app platform log retrieval

testId.description: Test ID — required for test get and logs get

name: automationQuery
title: Automation Query
